comment: The SAME BOM as clean.csv, reviewed with no end application stated. `default` is not a profile a user can pick — it is the absence of an answer, and `config_for` gives it the strictest setting of every rule (SpinZero plan §4). So a board that is clean for a commercial application is NOT clean when nobody has said what it is for, and this fixture is the pair that makes that visible: clean.expected.json forbids these four rules, this one requires them. If the two ever agree, the inversion has been undone.
